title: Seven South OTT Releases This Week: Paradise, Dorothy Lead Streaming Lineup
excerpt: Nani's The Paradise arrives on Netflix October 22 and Keerthy Suresh's Dorothy follows October 23, alongside Varam, Naa Wife Missing, Dhoomakethu and two returning ZEE5 series.
body:
• The Paradise, starring Nani, streams on Netflix on October 22, 2026, in Telugu with Hindi, Tamil, Kannada and Malayalam versions, according to its release poster.
  • Dorothy, starring Keerthy Suresh, Sananth and Rishikanth and directed by Karthik Subbaraj, is listed for Netflix on October 23, 2026 — one roundup notes Netflix has not formally announced that date, so check the app on the day.
  • Two Telugu series also land October 22: Varam on JioHotstar and Naa Wife Missing on Aha Video.
  • For US viewers: the sources list India platform and date details and do not state separate US availability for the Aha, JioHotstar or ZEE5 titles, so confirm each title in your local platform catalogue before planning a watch.

South Indian cinema dominates this week's streaming calendar, with seven Telugu, Tamil, Malayalam and Kannada titles arriving between October 22 and October 23, according to Pinkvilla's weekly roundup. A second roundup from 123Telugu confirms the same core dates for the biggest titles.

The two Netflix films leading the week

The Paradise — Netflix, October 22, Telugu. Cast: Nani, Mohan Babu, Kayadu Lohar, Sonali Kulkarni, Raghav Juyal, Sampoornesh Babu and Easwari Rao. Director: Srikanth Odela. Set in 1980s Secunderabad, the action drama follows Jadal, a young man who fights for the identity and dignity of his marginalised Savaari community, taking on the powerful Malik family after drawing courage from his mother Sammakka. Telugu Scope reports the release poster lists five languages — Telugu plus Hindi, Tamil, Kannada and Malayalam — and notes it is not yet clear whether Netflix will carry the theatrical cut or a longer version with trimmed scenes restored.

Dorothy — Netflix, October 23, Tamil. Cast: Sananth, Rishikanth, Keerthy Suresh, Ramachandran Durairaj, Muthazhagi and Jeeva Subramanian. Director: Karthik Subbaraj. Set in the 1980s, the drama follows childhood friends Karthi and Subbu, who grow up as henchmen under Subbu's father, Whistle Veeraiah, before the death of Dorothy, Subbu's sister-in-law, under mysterious circumstances changes their lives. Telugu Scope adds that Dorothy was made in Tamil and will be available with a Telugu dub, and cautions that Netflix has not formally announced the October 23 date.

Dhoomakethu — Netflix, October 23, Malayalam. Cast: Sajin Gopu, Nikhila Vimal, Ganapathi S. Poduval, Shine Tom Chacko and Sidharth Bharathan. Director: Sudhi Maddison. In this time-loop comedy, Kuttan, a 36-year-old whose wedding day turns violent, keeps waking up on the morning of the same day each time he dies, to save his bride Sharmila and break the cycle.

The series arriving October 22 and 23

Naa Wife Missing — Aha Video, October 22, Telugu. Cast: Varun Sandesh, Shweta Basu Prasad, Praveen, Mohith and Jabardasth Sathya Sri. Director: Swatiprakash Mantripragada. A newly married couple's life is upended when the wife disappears, and the husband's appeal to authorities surfaces doubts about her past.

Varam — JioHotstar, October 22, Telugu. Cast: Vishwadev Rachakonda, Shivathmika Rajasekhar, Srinivasa Avasarala and Sruthy Jayan. Director: Aditya Mandala. Raju, a poor slum dweller, gains a power to see tomorrow's news in advance and finds using it to escape poverty carries dangerous consequences.

Sattamum Needhiyum Season 2 — ZEE5, October 23, Tamil. Cast: Saravanan, Varalaxmi Sarathkumar, Lavanya and Prem Kumar. Director: Balaji Selvaraj. Advocate Sundaramoorthy takes on a new case that uncovers institutional corruption and tests his principles.

Ayyana Mane Season 2 — ZEE5, October 23, Kannada. Cast: Kushee Ravi, Akshay Nayak, Manasi Sudhir and Ramesh Indira. Director: Ramesh Indira. Jaaji takes charge of her ancestral mansion, faces relatives seeking the estate, and hears her late mother-in-law's voice claiming her death was not natural.

What this means for diaspora viewers

For viewers in the United States, the practical step is to search each platform as listed above on its stated date. The sources for this guide give the India platform and date for every title, and they do not state separate US release dates or US catalogue availability for the Aha Video, JioHotstar and ZEE5 titles. For the Netflix films, check the title page in your region — especially for Dorothy, where one source explicitly noted the date had not been formally announced by Netflix. Language options confirmed in the sources are the five-language release for The Paradise and a Telugu dub alongside the Tamil original for Dorothy.

What to watch first

If time is short, the sources point to The Paradise on October 22 as the week's most prominent Telugu title, followed by Dorothy on October 23. Viewers who prefer series can start with Varam or Naa Wife Missing on October 22, with the two ZEE5 second seasons following a day later. Platforms sometimes add festival-week titles at short notice, so the lineup may still grow before the weekend.
